newsitem.title: POLAND: Standard & Poor's to rate Polish city of Krakow.
newsitem.headline: Standard & Poor's to rate Polish city of Krakow.

text.p: Standard & Poor's will shortly issue a credit rating for Poland's southern city of Krakow, which plans to issue municipal bonds in 1998, a city official said on Friday.
"A rating of the Krakow city's commune carried out by US Standard & Poor's company will be issued in the next few days," Piotr Tutak, Krakow deputy president's assistant, told Reuters.
The city asked for the rating ahead of the planned issue of municipal debt paper, city treasurer Leslaw Fijal said. He gave no further details.
"The city is preparing for the issue of municipal bonds, which is written into its budget draft, and for placing it on international markets," Fijal said.
In June, the central city of Lodz received a BBB minus rating, the same rating as Standard & Poor's has assigned to Poland's sovereign debt.
